ai.title: Restrict mid-turn conversation summaries to near-limit context band
ai.summary: The agent runtime now starts mid-turn conversation summaries only when the context size reaches `summaryBandStart`, a threshold one growth step below the compaction limit, instead of at every 30k token interval. This change reduces background LLM requests by limiting summary generation to the narrow band where the summary will actually be used at the context limit, as mid-turn summaries started below the band were replaced by later turn-end or limit-time summaries before ever being read. The diff also adds a `stoppedOverBudget` flag to skip post-failure summarization when compaction left the run over its hard budget, and adds `summary_context_tokens` to the `COMPACTION_ATTEMPT_FIELDS` Axiom allowlist for operational telemetry.

ai.title: Cap attached tool result images to prevent runner OOM
ai.summary: The agent runtime now caps the number of images attached to tool results before sending the request history to the model. A new function, capToolResultImages, limits the history to MAX_ATTACHED_TOOL_IMAGES (8) and MAX_ATTACHED_TOOL_IMAGE_CHARS (16000000), keeping only the newest images and detaching older ones with a note. This prevents out-of-memory kills on Cloud runners, which previously grew to the 8 GiB limit when histories contained hundreds of large page images.

eli5.text: The assistant now limits the number of images from its own work that it keeps in its memory of a long conversation, retaining only the most recent ones. For you, this means your coding sessions are less likely to freeze or fail unexpectedly during lengthy tasks that involve multiple image files, though no new features or settings appear in the interface.
